notes: Blocked on this check: consumerfinance.gov (CFPB), cdc.gov, ready.gov, foodsafety.gov and fsis.usda.gov returned 403 to automated reads, so nothing was taken from them. consumer.ftc.gov and ftc.gov returned 404. Not worked round; a person can open them in a browser and add links later. medlineplus.gov and nhlbi.nih.gov opened. All old medicine in the old books (bleeding, patent tonics, cures, dosing, tobacco and alcohol advice, first aid) is outdated and some is dangerous; every old health line must be flagged against a current NIH, MedlinePlus or Red Cross source. No health disclaimer screens per house rule; cite sources on the cards instead.
